steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: So close... so close... Ah!!!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Eve! How did you fall?

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: You can call us if you need something.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I want to stand up. I got very close to doing it just now.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Why do you want to do that all of a sudden? Did the factory bosses blame you again?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Emm... No... Mom and Dad are probably quite busy lately. I haven't talked to them for a long time.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: This is something I want to do for myself.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I always hear you say that it's great outside. Bass says you can make a lot of friends out there, and Benna always mentions his family.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: After hearing so much, I want to see for myself. And...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I promised Bone I will stand up and take it for a walk.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Eve...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Polly, how come you rarely talk about your life outside? Is it as good as they say?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Your family... Are they as busy as my mom and dad?

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: ...Yes, just like they said, it's great outside. My mom and dad... are also great.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Right. Here, take this as a commemorative gift for the first day of Eve's recovery plan!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Ah, this doll! Where did you find it? I used to like her a lot.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: There was a piece missing from her face. She wasn't that pretty anymore... just like me.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: You hid her because you didn't want me to be sad when I saw her. I know.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: But look, I fixed her with my sewing skills. As good as new!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: The doll is fixed so there's no need to hide it... Everything will get better.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes... My legs, and Polly's face, will all get better!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Polly deserves the prettiest, most perfect doll.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: The factory... will get better too, right...?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hmm?

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Nothing. It's not important anymore.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: The most important thing right now is to help Eve stand up!
